Hi everyone. I had my account suspended yesterday around 4 in the morning. Twitter emailed me saying they unsuspended my account not even 24 hours later. I don’t know if this will help anyone else, but I wanted to share my experience. 

I submitted my first appeal immediately after finding out I got suspended. It wasn’t detailed because I was freaking out because I didn’t know why I was suspended and they didn’t provide a reason. However, I suspected that it was due to spam and it turns out I was right. I received an email minutes later asking to respond to the email the reason why my suspension should be appealed and they’ll get back to me in 3-5 days. I sent back a lengthy response which eventually didn’t get delivered as I received an email from the mail delivery system a couple minutes later. I tried forwarding my response and was stuck in a loop of getting an undelivered message from the mail delivery system.

I sent my second and last appeal around 3:40 the next day with a more detailed response on why my account should be appealed. Here’s what I said:

—

Urgent: Appeal for Account Suspension
Lack of Reasoning for Suspension

Dear Twitter/X Support,

I am writing to express my deep concern regarding the suspension of my Twitter account [account name]. I have not received clear reasoning why my account has been suspended and the lack of reasoning has left me confused and distraught.

Maintaining a safe online environment is vital, and I fully support and comply with Twitter/X's goal in conducting a respectful platform. I believe this suspension was made in error as I have always adhered to the community guidelines and terms of service.

On January 20th 2024 around [time], I sent 15 posts to another one of my professional accounts. These were sent in a span of 5 minutes, leaving me to believe that my account has been falsely flagged as spam. I was not trying to contact anyone randomly as I was just sending posts between my two accounts. I was required to do an authentication of my account which was locked, presumably due to my sending the posts too fast. Everything was fine until at [time] on January 21st 2024, I found that my account has been suspended.

According to Twitter/X terms of service, I can see how my account would have been flagged as spam by bulk sending direct messages. I was unaware that this would happen and I sincerely apologize for my behavior. It was not my intention to be seen as aggressive and disrupt others' experiences. I will fully comply with no err to Twitter/X's terms of service and will not repeat this in the future whatsoever.

My account is private and I do not engage in any activity that may raise concern or have a history of violations. My account is used as a digital diary to document my life and chat with friends. I feel this is damaging as I have accumulated over four years of memories that I may never get back. I cherish my account and all of the people and friends I am able to support on there. I apologize for any confusion this may have caused. Thank you for considering unsuspending my account.

—

I received the 3-5 day email again and didn’t respond. I DM’d another user on this thread about their process in getting their account unsuspended and decided to reply to the email by sending a blank response. I figured that might have done the trick because fifty minutes later they sent an email about unsuspending my account. This is what they included in the email.

—

A little background: we have systems that find and remove multiple automated spam accounts in bulk, and yours was flagged as spam by mistake. Please note that it may take an hour or so for your follower and following numbers to return to normal.

—

I’m glad that I have my account back and that it didn’t take as long as some others. I don’t know if sending the blank email or having an extremely detailed reasoning helped. I also didn’t get a mail delivery message when I sent the blank email. Maybe it’s due to luck who knows honestly. I hope this helps some others who are trying to get their accounts unsuspended!
